sources.capture: 18 already observed public listing links; no blocked article crawl. Additional demo metadata from official github.com/codrops repositories.
sources.previews: Repository previews come from the official github.com/codrops repositories via the authenticated GitHub API: committed images pinned to the default-branch commit on raw.githubusercontent.com, README image URLs on other hosts stored for browser hotlinking without being fetched, otherwise GitHub-generated social cards (opengraph.githubassets.com).
sources.videos: Not collected: the hosted demos live on tympanus.net, which disallows AI crawlers and returned HTTP 403.

Icon names, categories and tags from https://unpkg.com/@tabler/icons@3.51.0/icons.json; SVGs linked, not copied.

Refero itself was not crawled (AI crawlers are disallowed there). Brands already present in the existing Refero index were captured on their own public homepages, only when that site's robots.txt allows ClaudeBot/anthropic-ai/GPTBot (or, with no AI-specific group, the * group) on '/'. Consent banners were not accepted. Each capture's `source` is the brand's Refero style URL.
